description: AutoStream is a SaaS product offering automated video editing tools for content creators.

documents.title: Basic Plan Pricing and Features
documents.content: Basic Plan costs $29/month. It includes 10 videos per month and supports up to 720p resolution.

documents.title: Pro Plan Pricing and Features
documents.content: Pro Plan costs $79/month. It includes unlimited videos, supports 4K resolution, and includes AI captions.

documents.title: Refund Policy
documents.content: No refunds are available after 7 days from purchase.

documents.title: Support Policy
documents.content: 24/7 support is available only on the Pro plan.
